title: AP2 failure: mandates_not_supported and fallback to a non-agentic flow
summary: A verifier that does not use mandates for an action answers mandates_not_supported. The agent hands the purchase back to the user.

steps.label: Present a Checkout Mandate
steps.detail: The agent tries to complete a checkout with a mandate at a merchant that has not implemented AP2 for this action.

steps.label: Checkout Receipt: status Error, mandates_not_supported
steps.detail: Not terminal for the purchase: it may signal a fallback to non-agentic flows.

payload.content:
# Illustrative example, spec version v0.2. Decoded view; hashes and signatures shortened.
# Checkout Receipt JWT payload (checkout_receipt.json).
{
  "status": "Error",
  "iss": "https://shop.example",
  "iat": 1791760300,
  "reference": "r4Tz...hash-of-presented-mandate",
  "error": "mandates_not_supported",
  "error_description": "This merchant does not accept mandates for checkout."
}

steps.label: Hand the checkout to the user
steps.detail: The agent hands over to a flow the user completes without mandates, for example the merchant's own checkout page. AP2 does not define this handover.
